info.name: LOVEWANSHI Milan - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive, production-ready Postman collection for LOVEWANSHI Milan Backend & Chat Services.
Includes automated JWT token saving, realistic payloads, request parameters, and complete coverage of all User, Admin, Reference, and Chat endpoints.
